scope.goal: Align the Functions runtime and local emulator target with stable Node.js 22 support.

security_invariants.rule: The selected runtime must be stably supported by Cloud Functions for Firebase.
Local emulator and declared deployment runtime must use the same major Node.js version.

freshness_evidence.official_source: Firebase Functions runtime documentation checked 2026-11-18; Node 20 and Node 22 listed as supported.
freshness_evidence.project: Node 24 observed locally; Firebase emulator dependency rejected Node 24.
